llm_response.reason: The URL structure, appended 844 phone number, and abuse of Azure hosting (web.core.windows.net) match well-documented technical support scam tactics. Multiple internet forums, scam databases, and security sites directly link this phone number and similar URLs to pop-up-based tech support scams. These scams typically display fake virus or system error warnings urging users to call non-official numbers to then solicit payments or remote access, using urgency and psychological manipulation. This fits several characteristics of scam sites including fake error alerts, unauthorized use of company names and logos, psychological pressure, and inappropriate contact information.
